semiconductor_relevance: Medium — GEMI TEK CORP., through its subsidiary Jieliang Technology, provides essential maintenance and support services for semiconductor fabrication equipment.
summary: GEMI TEK CORP., via its subsidiary Jieliang Technology, offers specialized repair and maintenance services for chilled water machine equipment critical to semiconductor fabrication. As the sole authorized service center for ATS in Taiwan, the company focuses on equipment efficiency and technical support, utilizing high-precision HF gas analyzers for testing services.
capabilities: Technical repair and maintenance of chilled water machines
Logistics support with specialized machine pickup and delivery

regional_presence.Taiwan: Jieliang Technology operates as the only authorized service center for ATS, providing comprehensive support for semiconductor equipment in Taiwan.
